hook.from: Geography > Location, Terrain, Natural resources; Economy > Exports
hook.excerpt: Southern Africa, east of Zambia, west and north of Mozambique || narrow elongated plateau with rolling plains, rounded hills, some mountains || landlocked; Lake Nyasa, about 580 km (360 mi) long, is the country's most prominent physical feature; it contains more fish species than any other lake on earth || Resources: limestone, arable land, hydropower, unexploited deposits of uranium, coal, and bauxite || Exports: tobacco, tea, dried legumes, soybean meal, raw sugar (2023)

physicalGeography.excerpt: narrow elongated plateau with rolling plains, rounded hills, some mountains || Southern Africa, east of Zambia, west and north of Mozambique

climate.excerpt: sub-tropical; rainy season (November to May); dry season (May to November) || flooding; droughts; earthquakes

economy.excerpt: low-income East African economy; primarily agrarian; investing in human capital; urban poverty increasing due to COVID-19; high public debt; endemic corruption and poor property rights; poor hydroelectric grid; localized pharmaceutical industry || Exports: tobacco, tea, dried legumes, soybean meal, raw sugar (2023) || Industries: tobacco, tea, sugar, sawmill products, cement, consumer goods
